title: The enemy wants you to feel alone.
paragraphs: The enemy wants you to feel alone.

The enemy whispers:
"You don't belong anywhere."
"To all who received Him, He gave the right to become children of God." — John 1:12

You are not abandoned.
You are not forgotten.
You are God’s child.
You belong to the family of heaven.
Someone on your list needs this reminder today.
